text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias. AI systems learn from data, so if that data contains unfair patterns, the AI can make biased decisions in hiring, lending, or policing. This is why fairness matters—we must carefully test AI to ensure it treats everyone equally. Privacy is another key issue. AI often collects huge amounts of personal information, so we need strict rules to protect people's data. Transparency is equally vital. Users should understand how and why an AI makes a decision, not see it as a mysterious black box. Ultimately, responsible AI development means putting human values first and continuously reviewing these systems to prevent harm.
